_comment: Download sizes setup.sh shows when the Hugging Face API is unreachable (bytes; 2026-10-20; ornith1.5 and nemotron-super-vl 2026-10-22: the whole Hub repository at the pinned revision, from the Hugging Face API). pending_publication: the Hugging Face repository is not public yet, so there is no revision to pin; setup serves only a local copy (--models-dir) until the revision is recorded and the marker removed. checkpoints: the whole HF repository at the listed revision. packages: the Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.13 artifacts of release/requirements-0.32.lock (PyPI file sizes). wheel: release/merlin-wheel.sha256's wheel. venv_factor: installed size over download size, an estimate for the disk check.
